Opposite Party/s

 Appearance :

 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Umanath Mishra, Adv.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Harish Kumar
 Oral Order
2 03-12-2025
Heard learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 192(C) of 2024,
wherein cognizance has been taken under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Present complaint case has been filed by the opposite party no. 2 by making allegation of torture and demand of dowry and the petitioner is none else, but the husband of the opposite party no.2.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.84598 of 2025(2) dt.03-12-2025 4.

Though the entire allegation has been completely denied and submitted that the present case has been instituted in order to put pressure upon the petitioner on the instigation made by some unscrupulous persons, moreover, she is getting interim maintenance of Rs. 2,500/-.

6. Re-notify this case after valid service of notice or on appearance of the opposite party no. 2 or on 14.01.2026, whichever is earlier.
7.
In the meantime, let there shall be no coercive action against the petitioner, till further order.
